notes.title: Wordlike v0.14: New Shop and Blanks, Balls, and Buffs
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 Wordlike v0.14 is here! 🎉[/h1]

[h3]⭐ New Features[/h3]
[list]
[b]2 New Events:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]🪆 Faceless Doll:[/b] Take it if you're ready to play exclusively Blanks, but don't break your promise...
[*][b]✍️ Pool Ball Contract:[/b] Sign it, and your Pool Ball packs will always contain your most played word length.
[/list]

[b]5 New Knick-Knacks:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]💳 Credit Card:[/b] Gains +2 points for every dollar you spend.
[*][b]👛 Purse:[/b] +1 multiplier for every dollar you have.
[*][b]⌨️ Blank Keyboard:[/b] x3 multiplier for a word that's all blanks.
[*][b]🏞️ Unused Film:[/b] +5 multiplier for every used blank.
[*][b]🪄 Magic Wand:[/b] Permanently gain a blank when you make an 8-letter word.
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]✅ Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]New Shop:[/b] Now features 3 slots for Knick-Knacks or Stickers and 2 slots for packs.
[*][b]Pool Ball Buffs:[/b] All levels have been buffed, and limits are removed.
[*][b]Monkey's Paw Buffed:[/b] Offers better utility.
[*][b]Magic 8 Ball Buffed:[/b] No risk of downgrading levels.
[*][b]Piggy Bank Buffed:[/b] Choose specific Knick-Knacks or Stickers to sell and get 4x their sell value.
[*][b]Tile Stew Buffed:[/b] Now grants more points.
[*][b]Wheel Buffed:[/b] Bankruptcy has been removed.
[*][b]Piano Nerfed:[/b] Balancing changes applied.
[*][b]Disabled Buttons:[/b] Now appear more obvious.
[/list]

[h3]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Joker Fix:[/b] Now copies Easel properly.
[*][b]Easel and Funnel Fix:[/b] Synergize correctly now.
[*][b]Tooltip Cutoff Fixed:[/b] Tooltips are no longer cut off.
[*][b]Reject Fix:[/b] Works on Re-roll Contract as intended.
[*][b]Board 4 Fix:[/b] No longer shows empty Knick-Knack packs.
[*][b]Promise Fix:[/b] Can now be copied by the Joker.
[*][b]Printer Fix:[/b] Quickly pressing "Continue" doesn’t break the UI.
[*][b]Blue Pill Fix:[/b] Doesn’t break the Board anymore.
[*][b]The Mask Fix:[/b] Text is now displayed correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Wordlike v0.13: Tile Packs, Traits, and Tactical Boards!
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 Wordlike v0.13 is here! 🎉[/h1]

[h3]⭐ New Features[/h3]
[list]
[b]3 New Events:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Gift Exchange:[/b] Bring a Knick-Knack to share and receive a rarer one in return.
[*][b]Piggy Bank:[/b] Sell all of your Knick-Knacks and get triple their sell value.
[*][b]Tile Stew:[/b] Stir up your tiles; they’ll all get a random new letter and gain 2 points.
[/list]
[b]4 New Contracts[/b]
[*][b]Tile Packs:[/b] Choose a selection of 4 exquisite tiles. 💠
[*][b]Knick-Knack Traits:[/b] Knick-Knacks now have a chance to be Digital, Antique, Shiny, or Radioactive, each offering a unique boost. ☢️✨
[/list]

[h3]✅ Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]New Board Layout:[/b] Every board is now 4x4, with 4 boards to explore.
[*][b]Event Indicators:[/b] Boards now display icons indicating each event, helping you strategize.
[*][b]Hover Information:[/b] Hover over a board space for more detailed information.
[*][b]No Duplicate Pool Balls:[/b] Pool balls won’t appear as duplicates in packs anymore.
[/list]

[h3]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Shop Offerings:[/b] Sticker packs are now exclusively available in the shop.
[*][b]Chili Button:[/b] The Chili button can no longer be repeatedly pressed.
[*][b]Boss Debuff Fix:[/b] Losing to the “Consonants don’t score” boss no longer carries the debuff into your next run.
[*][b]Selling Funnel Adjustment:[/b] The effect of Selling Funnel is now removed immediately upon sale, rather than taking a turn.
[*][b]Tile Copy Fix:[/b] A copied tile no longer inherits the point boost from its original.
[/list]

notes.title: Wordlike v0.12: Sticker Bonanza
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 Wordlike v0.12 is here! 🎉[/h1]

[h3]⭐ New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]3 New Events:[/b]
  [list]
  [*][b]Spin the Wheel:[/b] Risk losing all of your Knick-Knicks for a chance at a free Exceptional one.
  [*][b]Sticker Printer:[/b] Enjoy a few stickers on the house.
  [*][b]Promise:[/b] Get a lot of multiplier if you keep your promise, but expect misfortune if you break it...
  [/list]
[*][b]16 New Stickers:[/b] Log, Crown, Chalk, Ring, Jacket, Bust, Pillow, Screw, Sword, Stamp, Compass, Pool Cue, Mushroom, Eraser, Stamp, Coin, and an updated Chili.
[*][b]Knick-Knack Packs:[/b] Purchase a case of Knick-Knicks for a broader selection.
[*][b]Sticker Sheets:[/b] Purchase a sheet of stickers and choose three of your favorites!
[/list]

[h3]✅ Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]More Shop Opportunities:[/b] You’ll now always visit the Shop after beating a level, providing more chances to optimize your build.
[*][b]Permanent Internet Slang:[/b] Slang words are playable without the Mask, though the Mask still boosts your multiplier for slang.
[*][b]Shop Re-Roll:[/b] Pay a few bucks to refresh the Shop inventory.
[*][b]Additional “?” Space:[/b] Every board now includes an extra “?” space.
[*][b]Magic Eight-Ball Buff:[/b] Now targets your most played word length, upgrading it by five levels if you’re lucky (or resetting it to level 1 if you’re not).
[/list]

notes.title: Wordlike v0.11: The Event Horizon
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 Wordlike v0.11 is here! 🎉[/h1]

[h3]⭐ New Events[/h3]
[list]
[*]Magic 8 Ball Event: Take a chance to upgrade one of your word lengths by multiple levels... or risk it being reset back to level 1.
[*]Bank Contract Event: Sign a lucrative contract to earn more money each turn, but be prepared to pay the cost.
[*]Red Pill, Blue Pill Event: Play it safe and reset the board, or take a bold risk and see how deep the rabbit hole goes.
[/list]

[h3]✅ Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Events are now integrated into the game board via question marks, adjusting frequency of existing shop and boss encounters.
[/list]

notes.title: Wordlike v0.10: Tile Enhancement Takeover
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 Wordlike v0.10 is here! 🎉[/h1]

[h3]⭐ Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Leather Tiles: Gains points the more you use it.
[*]Gold Tiles: Earn some $ every time you play it.
[*]Velvet Tiles: Adjacent tiles to this one gain more points.
[*]Blackboard Tiles: Converts the tile into a blank.
[*]Rust Tiles: Provides a x2 multiplier, but the tile is destroyed if not used.
[*]Diamond Tiles: Gives a higher multiplier, but the letter on the tile changes with every draw.
[/list]

[h3]✅ Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Consumables like Chili cannot be used on blanks and differentiate with Blackboard tiles
[*]Crystal Ball expanded to handle new tile enhancements
[/list]
